name: Temporary Residence for Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: Family reunification is available to spouses/common-law partners, minor children (including adopted), and, in more limited circumstances, other dependent relatives of a foreign national who already holds residence or citizenship in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The sponsor must submit a financial declaration meeting the income/means threshold set under Article 28(15) of the Pravilnik o uslovima za ostvarivanje prava stranaca na spajanje porodice (Rulebook on conditions for foreigners' right to family reunification), alongside proof of suitable accommodation and health insurance for the joining family member.
requirements.fix_path: Have the BiH-resident sponsor file the family reunification application with proof of the qualifying relationship, sufficient means under Article 28(15), suitable accommodation, and health insurance for the applicant.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying family relationship (marriage/birth certificate)
Sponsor's financial declaration meeting Article 28(15) threshold
Health insurance for the joining family member

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's residence status, typically issued and renewed annually

sources.title: Advokat Prnjavorac (Bosnian law firm/legal-text portal) -- Pravilnik o uslovima za ostvarivanje prava stranaca na spajanje porodice, Article 28(15) financial-means requirement, qualifying relatives
